reviews.text: Ben helped my extremely temperamental cat through a 27-hour plane trip plus an 8-hour car ride. It was a real miracle. We had a super smooth trip! Excellent job!!!
Ben is an amazing human being, and our Mel stayed with him, and the training had an immediate effect on her return home. I highly recommend him.

I loved the experience and the attention from the trainer; my dog ​​improved a lot after the lessons!
Thank you for the service.

Ben helped us when we needed to introduce a new kitten to the cattery. We had been trying for some time without success, and with his guidance and through the behavioral analysis he did at the time, we finally achieved a good result. In addition, he is a dedicated, attentive, easy-going, polite, and kind professional. He was also responsible for the training sessions when a new puppy arrived, focusing on proper handling. Thank you, Ben, for your help and care for our pets!

Ben is a very efficient and careful trainer!

Our Golden Retriever quickly achieved the goals, and the tips he gave us as owners were essential! I highly recommend him!

Excellent trainer, very patient, affectionate with pets, solved my big problem with my two cats who fought a lot. Today they are great friends. I recommended him to a friend who was also super satisfied with the result.
I recommend him!

We called Ben to help us move three cats to another country! The main complaint was a kitten with asthma who would get terrified in the carrier and, within minutes, would soil the entire carrier and become desperate. Traveling by car with her was impossible. Ben's help was essential; it allowed Irene to adapt to the carrier and make a peaceful, more than 6-hour trip without any distress. Besides noticing a change in her behavior, we were able to take her to the vet for her vaccinations without needing to restrain her. Irene became a completely different cat. It was a peaceful trip for all three. We are very grateful to Ben for all his care for the kittens and for his concern in reassuring us and accompanying us throughout the trip, as well as helping the cats adapt to their new home. He changed how we interact with the kittens, bringing us peace of mind and wisdom to handle the situation. Thank you so much.
Excellent professional! My children only receive compliments now!

My kittens, Branca and Tony, couldn't live together because the older female didn't accept the adopted kitten. After ten months of arduous and repetitive work, with training planned by Ben, they even play together. They are friends, not very close, but tranquility reigns in my house nowadays.
